title: orchis sambucina var. bracteata
intro: Orchis sambucina var. bracteata, commonly known as the green helleborine, is a type of orchid plant. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its leaves and roots containing bioactive compounds that exhibit therapeutic properties and potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of this plant include relieving pain and reducing fever, as well as its use in treating various gastrointestinal issues and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of the green helleborine include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
